scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the model equations, resistant and sensitive reproduction-number definitions, the resistant-phage equilibrium derivation, the G(lambda2) identity, the threshold theorem, and later ratio formulas. The displayed reproduction-number page and the downstream equilibrium page were visually inspected. The exact-rational checker replays the threshold reversal and equilibrium contradiction. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result establishes a missing adsorption factor in the displayed resistant-phage reproduction number and gives an exact counterexample to the literal threshold theorem under that displayed definition. It does not claim that every later numerical calculation in the article is wrong; several downstream identities are already consistent with the corrected expression. The counterexample concerns phage invasion of the resistant-only equilibrium and existence of the source's resistant-phage equilibrium, not stability against every possible perturbation.

title: The resistant-phage reproduction number in a CRISPR chemostat is missing an adsorption factor
